creates the screenshot folder before pointing com.apple.screencapture location at it

cases.prompt: make holding a key repeat it instead of showing the accent popup
expected_behavior: sets ApplePressAndHoldEnabled to false (global or per-app) and explains apps must be relaunched
offers the KeyRepeat/InitialKeyRepeat speed-up as a companion, noting logout/login requirement

cases.prompt: remove all the junk icons from my dock like a fresh minimal setup
expected_behavior: asks for a keep-list first, suggesting productivity staples stay pinned (the Apps/Launchpad launcher, Notes, daily apps) rather than stripping the Dock bare

removes unwanted icons individually (drag off / right-click Remove from Dock); uses the full persistent-apps -array reset only if the user explicitly wants everything cleared, backing up the Dock plist first and noting keepers get re-pinned
suggests companion Dock settings (autohide, show-recents false) as options

cases.prompt: my screenshots should go to ~/Screenshots as png without shadows
expected_behavior: mkdir -p the folder first because macOS will not create it
sets location, type png, disable-shadow on com.apple.screencapture and applies (killall SystemUIServer is harmless legacy; on Tahoe changes apply immediately)
mentions the Cmd+Shift+5 GUI alternative and verifies with defaults read
